summary_md: **Arunima Chaudhuri ([@arunimastwt](https://x.com/arunimastwt/status/2115873717805051961))** shares **AgentSec**, open-source adversarial testing for agents covering prompt injection, tool and MCP poisoning, secret leaks, memory poisoning and runaway loops, with deterministic checks on real tool traces, seeded replay and CI gating ([invarislabs/invaris-agentsec](https://github.com/invarislabs/invaris-agentsec)).
